name: bakery-khunkai-next
description: ระบบสูตรและต้นทุนขนม Bakery Khunkai — Next.js (App Router) + Cloudflare Pages + D1

scripts.preview: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages dev .vercel/output/static --compatibility-flag=nodejs_compat --d1=DB
scripts.deploy: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --project-name=bakery-khunkai-shop
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute bakery-khunkai-db --remote --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute bakery-khunkai-db --remote --file=migrations/0002_add_version.sql && wrangler d1 execute bakery-khunkai-db --remote --file=migrations/0003_add_conflict_log.sql
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute bakery-khunkai-db --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute bakery-khunkai-db --local --file=migrations/0002_add_version.sql && wrangler d1 execute bakery-khunkai-db --local --file=migrations/0003_add_conflict_log.sql
